prompt: Create a full-length instrumental fantasy game soundtrack song for Sporefen: a luminous fungal marsh, tall toadstools and green water beneath drifting spores. A softly enchanted theme with harp, airy strings and gentle pulse. Acoustic strings, soft flute, gentle hand percussion, memorable melodic theme, natural dynamics and a satisfying ending. No vocals, singing, speech, chanting, or spoken words. This is song 2 of two for this land; make it distinct and complete.
